Overview.Name: Tejasvi
Overview.Goal: Improve appearance, feel energetic and confident, support thyroid health, and maintain a lean, balanced physique with simple and controlled eating.

Meal_1_Breakfast: 2 whole eggs pan fried + cooked vegetables
OR Omelette with onions and vegetables
OR Paneer cubes pan fried + vegetables
Meal_2_Lunch: Chicken curry + 1 small cup rice + cooked vegetables
OR Fish pan fried + rice + vegetable curry
OR Eggs curry + rice + vegetable plate

Notes_and_Tips: Since sweets are a trigger, avoid keeping sweets at home and eat full meals on time to prevent cravings.
Focus on protein like eggs, chicken, fish or paneer in every meal to stay full and avoid overeating.
Keep meals simple and repetitive on busy or low-motivation days to avoid mindless snacking.
For boredom eating, drink water first or take a short walk before reaching for food.
Try to increase daily steps gradually toward 6,000–7,000 for better metabolism and thyroid support.
Avoid eating directly from packets; always plate your food to control portions.
Use ghee or butter for cooking and avoid refined or seed oils.
Consistency with simple meals will help maintain weight, improve energy and keep hormones balanced.
